description: Opportunity lifecycle. Salesforce orgs are heavily customized, so this is a deliberately thin starter — the real value (stage transitions) comes from OpportunityFieldHistory; see notes.
notes: Stage transitions live in OpportunityFieldHistory (Field='StageName', activity = NewValue). The builder's fixed-activity model can't take the activity from a value column — use the connector / MappingSpec activity_column melt or the Extraction Copilot for transition events.
